rows.prompt: A single seven-fingered ganja leaf held up against the rising sun, the light shining through it so every vein glows gold like a map of rivers, dew drops on its serrated edges, moody cinematic music-video photography with drifting haze, anamorphic lens flares, deep shadows and rich saturated color, shot on a full-frame cinema camera with shallow depth of field. Extreme close-up, the leaf filling the center of the frame, the sun a soft white flare behind it, misty green hills blurred in the distance. Warm golden backlight with an anamorphic flare streaking horizontally, colors of glowing lime green, gold and soft amber, no people, no text, no watermark.

Thick slow-curling white smoke curls through a single beam of morning light in a dark room, and its folds form a miniature landscape of rolling mountain ridges and valleys, moody cinematic music-video photography with drifting haze, anamorphic lens flares, deep shadows and rich saturated color, shot on a full-frame cinema camera with shallow depth of field. Medium close-up at eye level, the beam entering diagonally from the upper left, the smoke ridges glowing where the light cuts through them, the rest of the room in shadow. Hard golden sunbeam against deep black, colors of gold, smoke white and charcoal, no people, no text, no watermark.

A hand-carved coconut-shell chalice water pipe with a long coiled hose rests on a black stone table, and thick slow-curling white smoke rises from its bowl and turns into a slow spiral galaxy of glowing stars above it, moody cinematic music-video photography with drifting haze, anamorphic lens flares, deep shadows and rich saturated color, shot on a full-frame cinema camera with shallow depth of field. Low-angle medium shot, the chalice in the lower center, the spiral filling the upper two thirds against a black background. A soft ember glow from the bowl and starlight inside the smoke, colors of ember orange, deep violet, star white and black, no people, no text, no watermark.

Rows of hand-blown amber glass jars filled with frosted green buds glow like lanterns on dark wooden apothecary shelves, each jar lit softly from inside, thick slow-curling white smoke hanging in the air between the shelves, moody cinematic music-video photography with drifting haze, anamorphic lens flares, deep shadows and rich saturated color, shot on a full-frame cinema camera with shallow depth of field. Medium-wide view down the shelves at a slight angle, the nearest jar sharp on the right and the rest falling into soft bokeh. Warm amber light from the jars against cool dark shadows, colors of amber, honey gold, frosted green and deep brown, no people, no text, no watermark.

Perfect smoke rings float slowly across a dark room filled with layered haze, the haze lit in soft bands of red, gold and green light from tall windows, moody cinematic music-video photography with drifting haze, anamorphic lens flares, deep shadows and rich saturated color, shot on a full-frame cinema camera with shallow depth of field. Wide view at eye level, three smoke rings drifting through the center of the frame, rays of colored light slicing through the haze. Colored volumetric light against deep shadow, colors of ruby red, gold, emerald green and black, no people, no text, no watermark.
